pages.title: Seas of Different Temperatures
pages.text: Observation introduces ocean wildlife without pointless hunting.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Species have distinct ocean habitats. Whale Sharks are passive; predators are not pets. Working 1.0.7 feeding is explained in Lunch Without a Hand: drop one raw beef in water; hand right-click is not required.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Observe a Great White Shark or Whale Shark in its ocean without attacking. Species have distinct ocean habitats. Whale Sharks are passive; predators are not pets. Feeding needs the exact accepted native food for installed 1.0.7, not an arbitrary item from another version.
